strategies.name: Behavioral Detection of Python Execution in ICS

analytics.name: Analytic 2094
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies python.exe/py.exe or packaged Python runtimes launched from unexpected parents or locations, by unauthorized identities, or followed by communications to protected OT assets, system modification, or child interpreters. Alert only when the interpreter is not part of the asset's approved software/automation baseline or its execution context violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/user rule, and require OT-relevant corroboration such as access to engineering files, ICS software/API use, communications with protected OT assets, configuration change, or another suspicious follow-on behavior. Suppress documented vendor software, engineering workflows, diagnostics, backup, patching, and approved maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2095
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies python/python3 execution by unexpected users/services, from unapproved script paths, or from cron/systemd contexts not associated with documented automation, particularly when followed by OT communications, sensitive file access, persistence, or child-shell activity. Alert only when the interpreter/shell is not expected for the asset role or user/service context, or when its parent, path, arguments, remote-session source, or follow-on behavior violates the approved OT baseline. Suppress approved engineering scripts, vendor support, diagnostics, backup, patching, and maintenance windows.
